description_en: This operation queries all custom event sources
kebab_example: aliyun eventbridge list-user-defined-event-sources --name-prefix testName --event-bus-name testBus --limit 50 --next-token 100 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserDefinedEventSources

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the event source name
parameters.name: name_prefix

parameters.help_en: The name of the event bus
parameters.name: event_bus_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per request. You can use this parameter with NextToken for pagination. The maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh:
限定每次返回的最大条数，可以和NextToken搭配使用实现翻页能力。
注意每次返回的最大条数不超过100
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned from a previous call
parameters.help_zh: 当指定Limit时，如果还有多余的返回值则会返回NextToken
parameters.name: next_token
